messages.author: 7f3170e7815a360a
messages.subject: how to order a dot plot?
parts:
Hi all,

I have a hopefully quick question: how can I order the dot plots so that I can have results ordered by the size of the x variable?

I am trying this:

ggplot(data,aes(fixef,reorder(country,fixef))) + geom_point()

but it is not working. I am missing something here?

Thanks for you time.

Antonio Pedro.

messages.subject: Re: how to order a dot plot?
parts:
You're trying to reorder a factor, which doesn't giving the expected
results. Before your call to ggplot change 'country' to character:

d$country <- as.character(d$country)

Ben

messages.subject: Re: how to order a dot plot?
parts:
On Thu, Oct 11, 2012 at 6:10 PM, Ben Bond-Lamberty <bpb...@gmail.com> wrote:
You're trying to reorder a factor, which doesn't giving the expected
results. Before your call to ggplot change 'country' to character:

d$country <- as.character(d$country)

Ben


On Thu, Oct 11, 2012 at 8:28 PM, Antonio P. Ramos
<ramos.gra...@gmail.com> wrote:
> Hi all,
>
> I have a hopefully quick question: how can I order the dot plots so that I
> can have results ordered by the size of the x variable?
>
> I am trying this:
>
> ggplot(data,aes(fixef,reorder(country,fixef))) + geom_point()
